name: Minimum Resources for Deadlock-Free / Max Processes
recognitionClueHinglish: n processes, har ek ko max k units, total R units — minimum R ya maximum n poochha hai (27 me se 7).
whatShouldComeToMind: Worst case: har process ek unit kam par atka ho.
generalSolvingApproach: 1. Har process ki max demand likho.
2. Worst-case: har ko (demand-1) units allocate karo.
variationsObserved: 'Could lead to deadlock' wale option ka ulta reasoning.
commonTraps: k-1 ki jagah k use karna.

name: Banker's Algorithm / Safe State
recognitionClueHinglish: Allocation, Max (ya Need) aur Available table diya hai; safe state, safe sequence, ya request grant hogi ya nahi poochha hai.
whatShouldComeToMind: Work >= Need wala process finish karo, Work me uska Alloc jodo.
generalSolvingApproach: 3. Koi bhi process jiska Need <= Work ho use finish karo, Work += Alloc.
4. Sab finish to safe, warna unsafe.
5. Request ho to pehle tentative grant karke safety check karo.
variationsObserved: Kaunsa request (ya kaunsa process pehle) safe sequence deta hai — options ko ek ek test karo.
Non-preemptive allocation policy ke saath multiple resource types.
commonTraps: Need ki jagah Max compare karna.
Work update me Alloc add karna bhool jaana.

name: Deadlock Detection: RAG, Lock Scenarios, Wait-for
recognitionClueHinglish: Resource allocation graph ya processes ke request/release sequences diye hain aur deadlock possible hai ya nahi, ya kaunse process deadlock me hain.
whatShouldComeToMind: Lock/semaphore code me interleaving se circular wait bana kar dekho.
generalSolvingApproach: 1. Har process kya hold karta hai aur kya maang raha hai likho.
3. Multi-instance me cycle ke baad bhi check karo ki koi process finish ho sakta hai ya nahi.
variationsObserved: Priority/timestamp based request logic me deadlock ya starvation.
Semaphores ke saath 3 processes ka code segment.
commonTraps: Multi-instance me cycle ko hamesha deadlock maan lena.

name: Prevention / Avoidance Theory & Coffman Conditions
recognitionClueHinglish: Kaunsi scheme valid prevention hai, kaunsa statement galat hai, necessary conditions kaun si hain.
whatShouldComeToMind: Prevention = ek Coffman condition todna; avoidance = safe state check.
Resource ordering circular wait todta hai.
generalSolvingApproach: 1. Har option ko dekho ki kaunsi condition tod raha hai.
2. Prevention vs avoidance ki definition se mismatch pakdo.
variationsObserved: Sab release karke hi nayi request: deadlock nahi par starvation possible.
commonTraps: Prevention aur avoidance ko ek doosre ki jagah likhna.
